title: Separate dashboard config mutation, validation, UMOP routing, and restart/reload boundaries
description: AstrBot dashboard config APIs combine schema validation, file upload paths, provider/platform CRUD, multi-config routing, and lifecycle reload. Rust should add a management config service boundary before exposing mutable dashboard config APIs.

files.change: Keep HTTP DTOs thin and delegate validation/mutation to runtime config services.
Centralize config read/validate/write/reload planning outside web handlers.
Model platform/message/session-to-config routing separately from conversation and pipeline stages.

criteria: Config mutation APIs do not write files directly from HTTP handlers.
Schema validation and default migration remain reusable from CLI/runtime.
UMOP routing is testable without running the dashboard.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-web && cargo test -p astrbot-runtime && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
